% Pattern: env/class/svmult. With the options envcountsame and envcountsect,
% each numbered environment of the class steps the counter of theorem, which
% the section resets and numbers.
% from 2311.01874
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.2
% want remark-1 remark 2.1
% want claim-1 statement/claim -
\documentclass[envcountsame,envcountsect]{svmult}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Each tree is a graph. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Each path is a tree. \end{lemma}
\section{Two}
\begin{remark} Each cycle is a graph. \end{remark}
\begin{claim} A claim of the class. \end{claim}
\end{document}
